title: transient-failures: patch_file rejected on signals/index.md before read_file satisfied scope enforcement in Phase 5a
description: In Phase 5a of spec.skill.md, patch_file was called on .moeb/signals/index.md before the file had been read in the current session. The scope-enforcement layer rejected the call. The agent recovered by calling read_file (which produced a 63KB overflow result) and then retrying patch_file successfully. This is a transient failure (iteration_count = 1 for the Phase 5a signal index update). The spec being authored by this run (moeb.retrospective-reviewer-treats-iteration-count-0-as) prescribes a Pre-Read Discipline fix to prevent exactly this class of failure, evidencing that the spec's proposed resolution addresses a real recurring pattern.
proposed_resolution: Add a read_file_range call at the start of Phase 5a's index update step — after grep_files identifies the target row and before the patch_file call — to pre-satisfy scope enforcement. Prefer read_file_range over read_file to avoid the 63KB overflow on large index files.
